1.title: Sailors Admit to Dealing Fentanyl-Laced Pills on U.S.S. Abraham Lincoln
1.summary: Officials said that the U.S. Navy service members continued to deal to other crew, even after one person on the carrier ingested a fentanyl-laced pill and died in 2023.

2.title: Democrats Put Aside Rifts With El-Sayed, Uniting to Win in Michigan
2.summary: Despite disagreements on Israel, more than a dozen Democratic senators met in Washington with the Michigan Senate nominee and emerged sounding optimistic.

3.title: U.S. Intelligence Warns of China Theft Over Sale of F-35 Jets to Saudis
3.summary: Internal reports, including one from the Pentagon’s Defense Intelligence Agency, say China could acquire U.S. jet technology through spying or cooperation with Saudi Arabia.

4.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
4.summary: The Federal Reserve unanimously voted to increase interest rates to 3.75%-4% from 3.5%-3.75% on Wednesday.

5.title: At Least 21 Dead in Gaza After Building Collapse, Officials Say
5.summary: The Israeli military said in a statement it “did not strike the building,” but did not say whether any strikes on nearby targets could have caused the damage.

6.title: US House votes to hold billionaire Epstein associate Leon Black in contempt
6.summary: Black - who had business ties to Epstein - declined to appear and provide documents related to the convicted sex offender.
